svg.text: Opening Night: the phase B slice, order by order
Three taught orders (the ghost shows once, or the trap teaches), eight judged ones; every fed table or box lights a lantern; about six minutes
Before: the arrival at dusk (0:00), Hoot's welcome. After O11: the Feast's long table in the lane, every lantern lit, the buddies cheer (5:40); then midnight (6:10).
Judged orders are drawn new every visit (tables mostly of 5, 6 and 8 buddies, boxes in thirds to eighths, two orders halving can never make). Each is one SkillShown event for g3.maths.unit_fractions:
right at the first hand-over, no help, at most one cut more than the fewest is SOLVED; the bar is 7 of 8 (MasteryRules). The numbers above are one example visit.
